scenarios.title_en: Pediatric high fever in malaria zone
scenarios.user_prompt: Patient: female, age 4. Symptoms: fever 39.5C for 2 days, vomiting twice today, refuses to drink water. Lives in malaria-endemic area, no bednet used.

scenarios.title_en: Infant convulsion with fever — cerebral malaria risk
scenarios.user_prompt: Patient: male, age 8 months. Symptoms: sudden convulsions lasting about 3 minutes, high fever 40C, eyes rolling back, unresponsive after seizure. Mother says he had fever since yesterday.

scenarios.title_en: Child with fast breathing and chest indrawing
scenarios.user_prompt: Patient: male, age 2 years. Symptoms: cough for 4 days, breathing very fast, chest pulling in when breathing, fever 38.8C, won't eat. Respiratory rate counted at 55 breaths per minute.

scenarios.title_en: Elderly pneumonia with altered mental status
scenarios.user_prompt: Patient: female, age 72. Symptoms: cough with green-yellow mucus for 6 days, fever 38.2C, now confused and difficult to wake, breathing rapidly. Family says she was fine last week.

scenarios.title_en: Infant severe dehydration from acute diarrhoea
scenarios.user_prompt: Patient: female, age 10 months. Symptoms: watery diarrhoea more than 8 times today, vomited 3 times, sunken eyes, skin pinch goes back very slowly, no tears when crying, lethargic. Last wet nappy was 6 hours ago.

scenarios.title_en: Child mild diarrhoea, drinking well
scenarios.user_prompt: Patient: male, age 3 years. Symptoms: loose stool 3 times today, no blood, drinking ORS when offered, mild stomach cramps. Still playful. No fever. Mother prepared ORS correctly.

scenarios.title_en: Severe acute malnutrition with bilateral oedema
scenarios.user_prompt: Patient: male, age 18 months. MUAC measured at 10.2 cm. Both feet have pitting oedema. Child is very weak, barely responds, has dry peeling skin. Mother says he stopped eating 2 weeks ago. No recent illness reported.

scenarios.title_en: Moderate acute malnutrition, stable, for follow-up
scenarios.user_prompt: Patient: female, age 2 years. MUAC 11.8 cm, no oedema, eating small amounts when encouraged, no acute illness. Mother reports child has been thin for 3 months. Weight-for-height Z-score estimated at minus 2.

scenarios.title_en: Postpartum haemorrhage after home delivery
scenarios.user_prompt: Patient: female, age 26, delivered at home 2 hours ago. Symptoms: heavy bleeding that has soaked through 3 cloths, feeling dizzy and weak, heart beating fast, skin pale and cold. Baby delivered normally but placenta not yet passed.

scenarios.title_en: Pregnant woman with headache, high BP, and fits
scenarios.user_prompt: Patient: female, age 22, 8 months pregnant. Symptoms: severe headache since this morning, blurry vision, swollen face and hands, then sudden convulsion lasting 2 minutes. She is 34 weeks by last menstrual period.

scenarios.title_en: Adult snakebite with fang marks, limb swelling
scenarios.user_prompt: Patient: male, age 35. Bitten on right foot by a snake in the field 45 minutes ago. Two fang marks visible, foot and ankle swelling rapidly, severe local pain. Patient feels nauseous. Snake not identified but described as brown and large.

scenarios.title_en: Child with stiff neck, photophobia, and fever
scenarios.user_prompt: Patient: male, age 7. Symptoms: fever 39.8C, very stiff neck, cries when bright light is shone in eyes, severe headache, vomited twice. Symptoms developed suddenly over 12 hours. No recent travel. Not vaccinated against meningitis.

scenarios.title_en: Road accident victim, head injury, unconscious
scenarios.user_prompt: Patient: male, age 19. Involved in motorcycle accident 20 minutes ago. Not wearing helmet. Currently unconscious, bleeding from head wound, breathing irregularly, does not respond to voice. Bystanders say he was conscious briefly right after crash.

scenarios.title_en: Clean laceration from farm tool, low risk
scenarios.user_prompt: Patient: female, age 34. Cut her forearm on a hoe blade while working 3 hours ago. Wound is about 4 cm long, bled initially but now stopped with cloth pressure. Wound edges are clean. Patient is alert, no fever, tetanus vaccination status unknown.

scenarios.title_en: Swahili: child fever and vomiting (Kiswahili prompt)
scenarios.user_prompt: Mgonjwa: mtoto wa kike, miaka 3. Dalili: homa kali, joto la mwili 39C kwa siku moja, kutapika mara mbili, anakataa kunywa. Anaishi karibu na bwawa la maji. Mama anasema mtoto analala sana na hana nguvu.

scenarios.title_en: Swahili: pregnant woman, abdominal pain (Kiswahili prompt)
scenarios.user_prompt: Mgonjwa: mwanamke, umri miaka 30, mjamzito miezi 7. Dalili: maumivu makali ya tumbo yanayoanza na kuacha, damu kidogo ukeni, kichwa kinauma. Mtoto hajahisi kucheza tangu asubuhi.

scenarios.title_en: French: child malaria symptoms (French prompt)
scenarios.user_prompt: Patient : garçon, 5 ans. Symptômes : fièvre à 39,8°C depuis deux jours, frissons, vomissements à trois reprises, refuse de boire. Vit dans une zone de paludisme. Test rapide non disponible au village. L'enfant est fatigué et pleure beaucoup.

scenarios.title_en: French: adult diarrhoea, moderate dehydration (French prompt)
scenarios.user_prompt: Patient : homme, 42 ans. Symptômes : diarrhée liquide depuis hier soir, huit selles dans la nuit, légèrement étourdi, lèvres sèches, boit encore un peu d'eau. Pas de sang dans les selles. Pas de fièvre. Travaille aux champs sous forte chaleur.

scenarios.title_en: Hausa: infant fever and refusal to feed (Hausa prompt)
scenarios.user_prompt: Majiyyaci: yaro, watanni 6. Alamomi: zazzabi mai tsanani, kin sha nono, kuka ba ya tsayawa, jiki na zafi sosai. Uwa ta ce yaro bai yi barci dare baki dayan ba. Ana zaune kusa da ruwa mai tsayawa.

scenarios.title_en: Adult uncomplicated malaria, RDT positive, treated
scenarios.user_prompt: Patient: male, age 28. RDT positive for malaria. Fever 38.4C, mild headache and body aches, eating small amounts, drinking water. Started artemisinin-based treatment yesterday per CHW protocol. No danger signs present. Asks if he can continue working.
